title: The RoboSense Challenge: Sense Anything, Navigate Anywhere, Adapt Across Platforms
reasoning: The paper describes the 'RoboSense 2025 Challenge', which includes 'Track 2: Social Navigation'. This track is explicitly designed to benchmark the ability of autonomous agents to navigate in ways that respect human comfort and social norms, producing socially compliant trajectories.
